name: breathing_sustain
character: A held chord that stops freezing after its first second: a slow wobble in pitch and level whose depth grows, so the partials seem to move.
provenance: starting value, not a measurement: the shape follows practitioner guidance - Ableton, 'Learn How to Make High-Impact Sounds for Movies and Trailers' (pitch and filter automation to climb, ramp an LFO's speed and depth together on a riser, automate distortion for movement); Violet Recording, 'Sound Design for Trailers' (build and release tension, the biggest impacts at the climax, near-silence before a hit); native Instruments blog, 'Epic movie trailer impacts' (layer, deconstruct, resample). Times are fractions of the span the recipe is placed in ({"chain": "breathing_sustain", "start_s": a, "end_s": b}).
